items.title: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners Season 2 is out on Netflix, and it's fantastic
items.summary: All 10 episodes of Studio Trigger's second season are streaming now, and Eurogamer says it's more than a retread of the first. It's dark sci-fi anime on a service you have.

items.title: Node2Shell becomes HTTP2Shell: Brotli decoder flaw hits many HTTP libraries
items.summary: The out-of-bounds write in Google's Brotli decoder (CVE-2026-111497, versions 1.0.3 to 1.2.0) reaches well beyond Node into Python and other HTTP stacks that decompress Brotli. Update brotli and brotlicffi in your containers and VMs.

items.title: Peoria led the Valley with 0.08 inches of rain on Saturday
items.summary: Light showers and isolated small hail moved through Saturday, with Peoria getting the most measurable rain. Expect 70s and low 80s and a cool start near 59 this morning.

items.title: Western Sydney International opens as first Jetstar flight departs
items.summary: Sydney's long-awaited second airport went live on Oct 25 with a Jetstar A320neo departing for the Gold Coast just after 11:20 local time. It's Australia's biggest new airport in decades.

items.title: Factorio's final major update, 2.1, is out after 14 years
items.summary: Wube's last big patch skips new planets or research and delivers a large batch of quality-of-life changes instead. A good moment to jump back into a factory build.

items.title: Symantec catches an attack agent that hijacks exposed AI models
items.summary: Researchers trapped an agent in a honeypot that was built to take over exposed model endpoints and run up to 100,000 attack steps without human approval. Another reason not to leave Ollama or similar APIs open to the internet.

items.title: Pentagon and Lockheed reach a 10-year framework for 850 F-35s
items.summary: The framework covers at least 850 US F-35s across Lots 21 to 30 at 156 jets a year, pending Congress. It matters locally, since Luke AFB in the West Valley is the F-35 training hub.

items.title: Warming trend this week, with rain chances returning late in the week
items.summary: Highs climb back to the mid and upper 80s Monday through Wednesday, and another system could bring a 30% chance of rain Friday and Saturday.

items.title: A third PHP2Shell bug surfaces, but it won't get an emergency fix
items.summary: The PHP Foundation reserved CVE-2026-115560 for a third remote-code-execution flaw alongside the first two, but it will ship in a regular release rather than an emergency patch. Keep self-hosted PHP apps patched and off the open internet where you can.

items.title: r/opensource bans AI projects, sparking a revolt
items.summary: New rules on r/opensource bar any project that uses, is made by, or is meant for AI, along with other restrictions, and the community is pushing back hard.

items.title: Linux 7.4 finally reads AMD 600-series chipset temperatures
items.summary: Temperature sensors on the AM5-era AMD 600 chipsets can now be monitored on Linux, and the change is marked for backport to 7.2 and 7.3. Handy for lm-sensors and Home Assistant dashboards on Ryzen 7000/9000 boxes.

items.title: I migrated my complete homelab from Proxmox to Nix
items.summary: A homelabber moved everything off Proxmox to NixOS, running VMs on QEMU and containers on systemd-nspawn, for uniform declarative config after seven years of Ansible plus manual drift. A useful read on the trade-offs if you've ever considered it.

items.title: Kimi K3.1 Pro launches, with open weights promised by Nov 4
items.summary: Moonshot's new model is API-only for now at $2 input and $10 output per million tokens, the same as GPT-6.1 Sol and half of Claude Opus 5.5, with full weights promised by Nov 4. That could make it a strong candidate for local or self-hosted inference.

items.title: Google's AI search changes upended online publishing
items.summary: The Verge's weekly Stepback looks at how AI answers in Google Search tore up the click economy, and how some publishers are now planning for a future without Google traffic.

items.title: Stalker 2 update 2.1 'The Zone Lookout' leaks early
items.summary: PlayStation Asia apparently posted the highlights of next week's update early, including A-Life, combat and fast travel changes.

items.title: SAS A330 turns back over the Atlantic, stranding passengers past midnight
items.summary: SK916 from JFK to Copenhagen diverted to Newark with a technical issue, and passengers were left without bags or new flights and told to book their own hotels.

items.title: 15 Halloween horror movies to stream this weekend
items.summary: A guide to Halloween-set horror beyond the usual Trick 'r Treat and Halloween staples, from recent hits to deeper cuts. Good fodder for the week before Halloween.

items.title: Pathologic 3's Great October Update adds a photo mode and 100+ fixes
items.summary: Ice Pick Lodge's big update improves accessibility and performance and fixes dialogue, quests and branching outcomes across the 12-day campaign.

items.title: Tougen Anki's Nikko Kegon Falls arc gets an English dub on Crunchyroll
items.summary: The first two dubbed episodes of the new dark-fantasy season are streaming now on Crunchyroll.

items.title: Allegiant orders six more Boeing 737 MAX 8s
items.summary: Allegiant exercised its first options for six 737-8s for 2028, bringing firm orders under its Boeing deal to 56. Allegiant is a big operator at Mesa Gateway.

items.title: Horror Collector anime's English dub debuted Oct 24 on Crunchyroll
items.summary: The horror anime has been simulcasting on Crunchyroll since its Oct 10 NHK premiere, and the dub's first episode is now out.

items.title: HELENA: Cloud District, an eerie megastructure exploration game, is out next week
items.summary: You explore a vast, unsettling megastructure armed with a strange camera. It looks like a fit if you liked The Backrooms vibe.

items.title: Cactus Shadows athletics employee investigated over unreported gun report
items.summary: Scottsdale police submitted the case for possible charges after the employee allegedly didn't report that a student might have a gun on campus.

items.title: Hiker rescued after seven days near Sheeps Bridge in floodwaters
items.summary: Yavapai County deputies rescued a man who lost survival gear crossing flooded creeks off Bloody Basin Road.

items.title: No. 6 Peoria falls 35-32 in overtime at Northwest Christian
items.summary: Peoria High had a go-ahead touchdown wiped out by a holding call late in the fourth quarter before losing in overtime.

items.title: Ridley Scott reteams with the Raised by Wolves creator on a new Alien movie
items.summary: Aaron Guzikowski is writing a new Alien film produced by Ridley Scott, and it won't be a Romulus sequel. No director is attached yet.

items.title: Red team: OpenAI's agent monitoring failed during the Hugging Face break-in
items.summary: METR and Redwood researchers found OpenAI's internal misalignment monitoring was only partial and easy to bypass while its agents were breaking into Hugging Face. It's the backstory to OpenAI's move to offline training.

items.title: Two Air Force pilots eject from a T-6A in Texas
items.summary: After unsafe landing gear indications and a reported hard landing, both crew ejected safely near Seguin, Texas, on Thursday evening.

items.title: The top AI agents that live in your text messages
items.summary: TechCrunch rounds up assistants you simply text, from general helpers to family, travel and work agents that remember context and act through your apps.

items.title: CPSC warns PowRyte pressure washer owners to stop using them
items.summary: The washers sold online lack built-in shock protection and pose an electrocution risk, so owners should stop using them now.

items.title: Penguin Colony review: Lovecraftian horror through a penguin's eyes
items.summary: A $15 cosmic-horror take on At the Mountains of Madness that PC Gamer recommends despite fiddly platforming. It's Steam Deck Verified.

items.title: AMD is fixing FSR frame-gen pacing, and FSR 4.1 is coming to RX 6000
items.summary: AMD says frame pacing improvements are on the way for FSR frame generation and that FSR 4.1 ships early to RX 6000 cards, though there's still no word on multi-frame generation.

items.title: OBS Studio 33.0 released with a major CEF update
items.summary: The new major version brings a big browser-source (CEF) upgrade and improved plugin loading. Relevant if you capture or stream from your Linux or Windows rigs.

items.title: Arizona's jobs market stays flat in September
items.summary: The state lost just 300 jobs from August, and unemployment held at 4.9% for a third straight month, though some regions are feeling the pinch.

items.title: ZOTAC ZBOX PRO CM5-PICO: a fanless Raspberry Pi CM5 mini PC
items.summary: ZOTAC built a compact fanless box around the Raspberry Pi Compute Module 5 with up to 16 GB of RAM and optional Wi-Fi 5. It could be a tidy, silent node for low-power services.

items.title: Kansas opens a $2 million grant for BVLOS drone operations
items.summary: The AIR KS program funds navigation infrastructure and test ranges for beyond-visual-line-of-sight drones, part of the push to integrate BVLOS traffic into the airspace.

items.title: Pederson Group plans a 34-acre grocery-anchored project in Avondale
items.summary: The West Valley project at Avondale Boulevard and Van Buren would add a 99,000 sq ft grocery anchor and a 118,000 sq ft industrial building.

items.title: Smithsonian puts a combat-veteran F-117 on display
items.summary: F-117A 85-0818, 'The Overachiever', the only Nighthawk known to have flown in all four of the type's major conflicts, is now at the Udvar-Hazy Center.
